notes: - Incoming voice notes, second attempt — with eyes open. 1.1.17's play-and-capture clicked the player *container* from inside the page, and on the real page nothing loaded (the play handler lives on the button itself). The press is now a real mouse click on the actual play control, and the watch for the sound covers the whole conversation, not just one element. And a failed fetch is no longer silent: the Activity log gains a `media.incoming_failed` line naming what the page showed at each step (what element, whether it had an address, what was pressed, whether anything loaded, how many audio responses the network saw) — so if a voice note still cannot be opened, the reason is readable in the dashboard instead of guessed at.
